gloss: to gather; to assemble; to come together

definitions.gloss: to gather; to assemble; to come together
definitions.explanation: For people to come together in one place, typically with a shared purpose or bond. More literary and evocative than {集|あつ}まる.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{志|こころざし}を{持|も}つ{人|ひと}たちが{集|つど}う{場|ば}がほしい。
examples.english: I want a place where people with the same aspirations can come together.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}この{祭|まつ}りには{全国|ぜんこく}から{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{集|つど}い、{町|まち}は{活気|かっき}にあふれる。
examples.english: Every year, large crowds gather from all over the country for this festival, and the town overflows with energy.

notes:
USAGE:
{集|つど}う is a literary, slightly elevated synonym of {集|あつ}まる. It implies people coming together with a shared sense of purpose, bond, or spirit — not just randomly being in the same place. It is common in written language, event names, and poetic contexts.

ASPECT (ている):
{集|つど}っている describes a state of being gathered together.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲間|なかま}が{集|つど}う (companions gather)
- {人|ひと}が{集|つど}う{場|ば} (a place where people come together)
- ～のもとに{集|つど}う (to gather under the banner of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集|つど}う: to gather (literary; implies shared purpose or bond)
- {集|あつ}まる: to gather, to assemble (everyday; neutral)
- {寄|よ}り{集|あつ}まる: to get together (casual, spontaneous feeling)

RELATED:
The noun form is {集|つど}い (a gathering, assembly).
